audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The printed radius comparison and its intermediate sufficient bounds are false; Proof uses full Lipschitz norms as if seminorms and replaces derivative-only h bound by full norm bound; Section4 omits w in conclusion and prints incorrect escape denominator, sign and remainder index
limitations: F1 — Counterevidence: Neither example refutes Proposition3.2: G zero on O and positive at other point (47/50 and999999/1000000). Tiny example has correct radius conclusion. Actual image has absolute value bars: OCR allegation discarded.
F2 — Counterevidence: Theorem3.10 explicitly defines Lip-dense as uniform approximation plus nearly preserved norm, not strong Lipschitz-norm density. No finding against the stronger unstated claim.

F3 — Counterevidence: Statement p21 includesw; initialvarrho p22 and (4.3)p23 use correctLipf; corrected remainder still has at mostNterms. Source mechanism supplies a positive escape cost; quantitative corrections retain it.
Not performed: Full external Bressaud-Quas combinatorial theorem proof.
Not performed: Full Greene-Wu smoothing theorem or general Bousch/Anosov adapted-iterate proof.
Not performed: Publisher-text equivalence, author code, human review.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
